summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, furnishing its updated Environmental, Social and Climate Risk Policy (ESC Policy) under cover of a foreign issuer report. The filing is a routine disclosure of internal risk management guidelines, not a transactional event. It outlines the bank's approach to integrating ESC risks into traditional risk management, based on Brazilian regulations. No special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring—is present. The filing simply reports a policy update with no financial terms, board actions, or deal mechanics.
